definitions.explanation: A small hill or rise in the ground. Can refer to a natural elevation or a man-made mound.

examples.english: I climbed to the top of the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小山|こやま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Children are playing on the small hill in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧{小山|こやま}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Fallen leaves had piled up into something like a small mound.

notes:
USAGE:
Can describe either a natural small hill or a pile of something that resembles a hill. Also a very common surname ({小山|こやま} or {小山|おやま}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小山|こやま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような (like a small hill — for piles of things)
- {小山|こやま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧ (to climb a hill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧: hill — generally larger than {小山|こやま}
- {塚|つか}: mound, tumulus — often a burial or ceremonial mound
